text:
kai: FYI ap-southeast1 had a weird micro-GPU clustering event during the morning spot reclaim cascade. dozens of 0.125/0.25 GPU pods ended up crammed onto two nodes in rack-12 then eviction churned. anyone monitoring placement oddities?
marta: saw it on infra-summary. scheduling_latency spiked to ~520ms and pod_bind_attempts surged. looks like offers reordered after cordon and the same nodes kept winning.
ben: what scheduler params are live in ap-southeast1? we enabled aggressive_pack_score (pack_multiplier=1.7) last week to squeeze idle GPU time.
kai: that is active. sample excerpt from pod dump:
```
NAME        STATUS   NODE     GPU
model-x1    Running  rack-12  0.125
model-x2    Running  rack-12  0.125
model-x3    Pending  <none>   0.125
model-x4    Running  rack-12  0.25
```
(full dump in s3://redwood-ops/incident/6532109876/dump.txt)
ops-bot: NOTICE: node rack-12 cordoned by cloud-controller at 2025-05-10T01:42:10Z (spot-evict).
marta: pack_multiplier multiplies fit score, so tiny requests become "super-fit" on small remaining slots. combined with offer ordering during cordon, that produced a positive feedback: same nodes chosen -> kubelet memory + ephemeral storage pressure -> evict -> reschedule -> cluster again.
ben: that aligns. latebind backoff also retried quickly which kept favoring first-responding nodes. warm-pool handoff was synchronous so multiple warm nodes handed over around same time.
kai: proposed quick fixes: 1) roll back pack_multiplier to 1.0 in ap-southeast1 (fast rollback) 2) enforce PodTopologySpreadPolicy for pods requesting <0.5 GPU across rack topology 3) add 30-90s random jitter to warm-pool handoff and to latebind retry.
marta: longer term: implement a "pack circuit" that drops pack_multiplier to safe=1.0 for 15m after any node cordon/evict burst in a zone; emit micro_cluster_ratio metric for Canary alerts.
ben: ops checklist: A) rollback pack_multiplier (marta) B) kick a controlled rebalance job that respects new spread policy (kai) C) add Canary eval and metric (ben).
ops-bot: ACTION created: INC-1623 "apse1 microgpu hotspot" assigned to kai, due 2025-05-10T03:00:00Z.
kai: one-more note: pack wins save ~9% GPU hours on average for steady-state but risk availability blips during spot storms. will include cost/availability tradeoff in the postmortem. rolling back now, will update when rebalance completes. :thumbsup:
